- **Professional Focus:** AI engineering — agentic systems, MCP servers, RAG

- **Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India

### Professional Summary
Selvin PaulRaj K builds agentic AI systems, MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, RAG pipelines, and LangGraph multi-agent workflows. At Zinnov (Draup) he works as an Associate Data Analyst on the AI automation team, where he architected DRI-MAS — a LangGraph multi-agent system that turns natural-language business requests into validated SQL reports, cutting analyst turnaround from hours to under a minute. He is pursuing an M.E. in Computer Science (AI specialization) at Kings Engineering College.

## DETAILED WORK EXPERIENCE

### 1. Associate Data Analyst — AI Automation — Zinnov (Draup)
**Duration:** September 2025 – Present (full-time)
**Location:** Arakkonam, Tamil Nadu, India (On-site)
- Architected DRI-MAS, a LangGraph multi-agent system that converts natural-language business requests into validated Trino SQL and structured Excel reports — analyst turnaround dropped from hours to under a minute
- Built its 10 core components (intent and manager agents, normalisation engine, schema router, SQL generator, memory layer, evaluation framework) behind 4 FastAPI endpoints, covered by 30 automated test suites
- Implemented hybrid retrieval (FAISS + BM25) over 2.6M company records with human-in-the-loop validation
- Built a Company Synonym Agent for entity resolution across 2.6M company and subsidiary records with sub-second lookups
- Automated business-signal monitoring for 537 enterprise accounts across 8 industries (Deal Origination Framework Agent)
- Delivered LLM-powered role mapping for enterprise clients, including 746 role–task–skill mappings
- Recognised with a SPOT award (Automation CoE, June 2026)
- Stack: Python, LangGraph, Claude API, FastAPI, Trino, PostgreSQL, FAISS, BM25, AWS S3/Glue, Playwright, Pydantic, pytest

### 2. Tech Intern — Zinnov (Draup)
**Duration:** June 2025 – September 2025
**Location:** Arakkonam, Tamil Nadu, India (On-site)
- Built the RMS Agent, an LLM-powered role-mapping system using Gemini and FAISS semantic search
- Automated Existing / New / Intern role classification with parallel batch processing
- Built scraper modules (Requests, BeautifulSoup, Playwright, GNews API) with deduplication
- Designed the architecture for a 6-stage business-signal intelligence pipeline
